chunks: "The sunnah (prophetic tradition) regarding nūrah is once every fifteen days. If twenty days come upon you and you do not have it, then borrow upon Allah, Mighty and Majestic."

key_terms.السُّنَّةُ: the normative prophetic tradition or recommended practice
key_terms.النُّورَةِ: depilatory paste used for removing body hair
key_terms.خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْمًا: a period of fifteen days, the recommended interval mentioned here
key_terms.عِشْرُونَ يَوْمًا: a period of twenty days, after which delay is discouraged
key_terms.فَاسْتَقْرِضْ: borrow, meaning to seek a loan if necessary

ai.seo_question: What is the sunnah (prophetic tradition) interval for using nūrah according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states the sunnah (prophetic tradition) concerning the regular use of nūrah, setting fifteen days as the normative interval. He further emphasizes personal cleanliness and grooming by instructing that if twenty days pass and one lacks the means, one should even borrow for the sake of Allah عز وجل.
